title: Derive and write the sprint Status transition automatically

verified_files.detail: Added issue_statuses, retro_path_for, derive_sprint_status, write_sprint_status. Derivation is one-directional: it can return 'CLOSED' or None, never 'ACTIVE'.
Derives and writes the header Status before the CLOSED freeze check, so a newly closeable sprint is written once and frozen from the next sync onward.
13 tests added covering every derivation rule, the writer's line-shape preservation, and two sync integration paths.

design_decisions.decision: A retro file must exist before a sprint can auto-close.
design_decisions.why: Without the interlock a sprint would flip to CLOSED the instant the last issue was marked DONE -- mid-session, as a side effect of an unrelated edit, before /solorail:evolve had run. Closure now follows the lifecycle instead of racing it.

design_decisions.decision: derive_sprint_status never returns 'ACTIVE'; CLOSED -> ACTIVE is not automated.
design_decisions.why: Auto-reopening would let an unrelated edit silently resurrect frozen sprint history. Reopening stays a deliberate human act (edit the header), after which sync resumes managing the board.

design_decisions.decision: A board with zero issue rows never auto-closes.
design_decisions.why: An unplanned sprint is not a finished one.

design_decisions.decision: Status is derived before the freeze check, and only for sprints not already CLOSED.
design_decisions.why: Keeps E03-ISS-01's freeze intact while still allowing the single ACTIVE -> CLOSED write to land.

definition_of_done.criterion: All new tests pass; full suite green
All rows DONE/CUT plus a retro transitions to CLOSED on one sync
definition_of_done.evidence: Live fixture sprint-05: rows DONE + retro present -> Status CLOSED

definition_of_done.criterion: Same fixture without a retro stays ACTIVE
definition_of_done.evidence: Live fixture: rows DONE, no retro -> Status ACTIVE

definition_of_done.criterion: A TODO row plus a retro stays ACTIVE
definition_of_done.evidence: Live fixture: one TODO row + retro -> Status ACTIVE

definition_of_done.criterion: Live sprint-02 stays ACTIVE and sprint-01 stays CLOSED and byte-identical
definition_of_done.evidence: sprint-02 ACTIVE with 6 open issues; md5 of sprint-01.md unchanged across a sync, which logs 'skipped ... Status CLOSED (frozen)'

definition_of_done.criterion: No automatic CLOSED -> ACTIVE transition exists
definition_of_done.evidence: derive_sprint_status returns None for a CLOSED board regardless of rows or retro; covered by test_never_returns_active

defects_closed: The sprint Status field had no writer at all; the ACTIVE -> CLOSED edit was made by hand during Sprint 01's evolve
A forgotten manual edit would have left two sprints reading ACTIVE, making resolve_active_sprint warn about ambiguous state on every hook invocation
notes: Unblocks E03-ISS-04: closing a sprint is what permits generating the next one. The evolve skill's prose still describes the manual transition; updating plugin skill text was explicitly out of scope here, so the code is now authoritative and the prose is merely redundant.
